assertions_satisfied: The 1.0.4 package loads all 17 catalog scene entrypoints through MuJoCo.
The wall and lever geometry gate passes strict chain reach, IK residual, joint-limit, fixture-clearance, reset, and static-integrity checks.
The trusted Harness executes the representative reach, wall, dial, and lever reference cases with physical validation enabled.
Each representative reference trial records a non-null task measurement and passes the physical trial verdict.
Each representative reference trial observes actuator control changes and no direct qpos, qvel, mocap, or external-force state writes.
The reference renderer uses the real MuJoCo path with the package's 800x600, 20 FPS configuration.
limitations: This is a diagnostic reference positive control, not a formal Experiment 3 denominator entry.
The focused Harness run covers four representative tasks; it does not claim closure of every private catalog task.
The run is not an SDK-grounded execution and makes no morphology or transfer-effect claim.
